The land was barren and infested with cobras and scorpions; Sri Swamiji slept under the trees on the bare ground with these creatures crawling all around Him. He was never harmed. It was there, at Mysuru, that Sri Swamiji came to be known as Sri Ganapathy Sachchidananda Swamiji

The meaning What is Guru Parampara? “Guru Parampara” is the combination of two words, Guru and Parampara. As per the sacred text Guru Geeta, the dialog between Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, the word “Guru” comprises of two words, “Gu” and “Ru”. Gu “Gu” represents darkness (ignorance) Ru “Ru” represents illumination “Parampara” means “uninterrupted succession”. So, Guru Parampara is the continuous succession or lineage of Gurus. Guru is like the Sun who swallows up the darkness called ignorance and blesses with illumination. Guru Parampara The lineage of Gurus Why the Guru No one can be at pa

A verse extolled in The Guru Geeta Gu kaarassyaad gunaateeto roopaateeto ru kaarakah Gu In this context, “Gu” implies He is above all attributes ( gunas ). Ru “Ru” implies He is beyond form ( roopa ). As He is the absolute Supreme Lord who is beyond traits and form, He has been addressed as Guru.

Lord Dattatreya Adi Guru — the Guru of Gurus Adi Guru Lord Dattatreya According to the determination of Brahma and as a consequence of the great penance of Sage Atri and Anasuya in the Kriya Yuga (the first of the Yugas / eons), Dattatreya, combining all the aspects of the Trinity — Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva — incarnated for the sake of his devotees. The word “Datta” means the one who has given himself, and since he was born to Sage Atri, he came to be known as Lord Dattatreya. Kriya denotes action. Kriya Yoga channels the life-force energy ( praana ) through mental processes to achieve this union, starting with pranayama , the control of breath.
